overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the executive session discussion of a counteroffer fell within Purpose 2, and a member's collaboration with labor counsel on a statement was not deliberation. A reminder about open-session minutes was given, not an order.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board entered executive session on the Police Chief negotiations without a valid purpose, since non-renewal was already decided.
allegations.key_passage: This is a discussion of negotiation strategy within the scope of Purpose 2, and it was therefore permissible to hold the discussion in an executive session.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board held secret discussions outside an open meeting on the contents of a written statement about the Police Chief.
allegations.key_passage: Because this collaboration would not constitute deliberation by a quorum of a public body, see G.L. c. 30A, § 18, it would not violate the Open Meeting Law.
